ns2:section.sectionText: 3 Credit Hours Recommended: SOCW 200 Course Description: Examination of sexuality topics from social work perspectives, embracing sexuality as a human right and approaching it from sex positive perspective and strengths-based and reproductive justice frameworks. Focus is on the application of social work skills, theories and values to integrate sexuality into the practice of social work, allowing attention to the sexual dimension, which is critical to clients' overall well-being. Through themes of breaking silences of taboo topics, case scenarios within practice settings and recognizing reproductive justice as a critical element of social justice, students will develop skills to engage clients more fully in relation to sexuality.
